```{r call-libraries} 
library(Giotto)
library(future); if(parallelly::availableCores() > 2 & .Platform$OS.type == "windows")  
  {plan('multisession', workers = parallelly::availableCores()-2)}
options(future.globals.maxSize= 1e12)
library(scran); library(MAST); library(leiden);    
library(data.table)
library(gplots); library(ggplot2); library(viridis)
library(dbscan)
library(dplyr); library(leidenAlg)
set.seed(43)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.retina = 2)
sessionInfo()

```


```{r readRDS-harmony-excl-annot}
sln <- readRDS("sln.clustering2.RDS")
plots <- list()
```


```{r subset-T-cells}
gc()
md <- pDataDT(sln); keepCells <- md$cell_ID[which(md$L1.annot == "Tcells")]
Tcells <- subsetGiotto(sln, cell_ids = keepCells )
print("recalculate clusters post-exclusion")
clusterChannels <- c("CD3E", "CD4", "CD8", "TCF1", "GZMB", "CD39", "KI67", "PD1", "TOX", "FOXP3", "ICOS", "CD45RA","HLA.DR")
Tcells <- runPCA(gobject = Tcells, expression_values = "normalized", scale_unit = TRUE, 
              method = "factominer", feats_to_use = clusterChannels)
signPCA(Tcells, scale_unit = TRUE, scree_ylim = c(0,40))
sln.sm <- subsetGiotto(gobject = Tcells, cell_ids = sample(sln$cell_ID, 1e5, replace=F)) # make a smaller dataset to work with 
sln.sm <- createNearestNetwork(gobject = sln.sm, dim_reduction_to_use = 'harmony', dim_reduction_name = 'harmony', 
                            name = 'NN.harmony', dimensions_to_use = 1:10, k = 10)  # calculate nearest neighbors, focus on global differences 
sln.sm <- doLeidenClusterIgraph(gobject = sln.sm, resolution = 0.3, n_iterations = 100, set_seed = T, seed_number = 43,
                                network_name = 'NN.harmony', name = 'leiden_Tcells')  # make the clusters
Tcells <- labelTransfer(x = Tcells, y = sln.sm, labels = "leiden_Tcells")  # assign cluster labels in the full dataset based on the reduced data
Tcells <- runUMAPprojection(Tcells, random_subset = 1e5)  # project UMAP coordinates to the full dataset based on a subsampling
saveRDS(Tcells, "Tcells.RDS")
```


```{r readRDS-harmony-excl-annot}
Tcells <- readRDS("Tcells.RDS")
plots <- list()
```
